title: The Structure-Based Molecular-Docking Screen Against Core Clock Proteins to Identify Small Molecules to Modulate the Circadian Clock.
one_liner_zh: 该文利用分子对接虚拟筛选针对核心时钟蛋白的小分子调节剂，虽涉及结构建模但对象为蛋白-小分子互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题关联度低。
abstract: Circadian rhythms are part of the body's clock, which regulates several physiological and biochemical variables according to the 24-h cycle. Ample evidence indicated disturbance of the circadian clock leads to an increased susceptibility to several diseases. Therefore, a great effort has been made to find small molecules that regulate circadian rhythm by high-throughput methods. Having crystal structures of core clock proteins, makes them amenable to structure-based drug design studies. Here, we describe virtual screening methods that can be utilized for the identification of small molecules regulating the activity of core clock protein Cryptochrome 1.
abstract_zh: 昼夜节律是生物体时钟的一部分，该时钟根据24小时周期调节多种生理和生化变量。大量证据表明，昼夜节律时钟的紊乱会导致对多种疾病的易感性增加。因此，人们已投入大量努力，通过高通量方法寻找调节昼夜节律的小分子。拥有核心时钟蛋白的晶体结构，使其适用于基于结构的药物设计研究。在此，我们描述了可用于识别调节核心时钟蛋白隐花色素1（Cryptochrome 1）活性的小分子的虚拟筛选方法。
